# OpenDock: extended context

OpenDock is a free, open-source dock and taskbar replacement for Windows 10 and 11, licensed under MIT. Current version: 0.2.0.

## What it does

- Replaces the Windows taskbar: pinned apps and open windows grouped by app, live window previews on right-click, and a screen-edge reservation so maximised windows stop at the dock.
- Start launcher with instant search over installed apps, pinning, and power actions that confirm before ending a session.
- 14 widgets: Start, Apps, Volume, Quick actions, Clock, Now playing, Focus timer, Todos, Notes, Next event (iCal calendars), System, Battery, Weather and Day progress.
- Automation Studio: rules made of an event, optional conditions and actions (for example, pause media before a meeting). Rules are JSON data, not scripts, with dry runs, an activity log, cooldowns, rate limits and Undo.
- Privacy Ledger: a local record of every network request.

## Privacy and security

- No account, backend, telemetry or remote configuration.
- Only the Weather widget (api.open-meteo.com, geocoding-api.open-meteo.com) and calendar feeds the user adds make network requests, through a host allow-list.
- Data is stored locally in %APPDATA%\com.opendock.app; calendar feed links are stored in Windows Credential Manager.
- The taskbar is restored on quit, crash (via a guard process), power actions, next start and uninstall.

## Technology

- Desktop app: Tauri 2 with a Rust core and a React 19 + TypeScript UI (apps/desktop).
- Shared schemas: Zod and Rust validators tested against shared fixtures (packages/config-schema).
- Storage: SQLite with migrations; settings in JSON.
- Website: static Astro site on Cloudflare Pages (apps/web).
